_note: Chapter 1 mission table for the campaign spine (docs/campaign-spine.md), authored from docs/re-notes/ch1/*.md. Times are game-clock hours; 'window' is [start, end) in fractional hours (18.5 = 18:30), start > end wraps midnight; omitted = always available. 'prereq' lists ids that must be completed first (completion is one-shot in v1). 'on_pass' is the SMissPass.lua equivalent: give_weapon (original numeric id or a Weapons.json id), give_ammo ({id, n} or a list; tops up to n), respect ({faction: value} — SET semantics, matching SFaction), force_complete ([ids]), chapter_set, unlock_collectible (name flag), money (cents — the wallet counts whole dollars), clock (pause | unpause | 'h:mm'). Unknown keys log a warning and are ignored. Star locations are location_cm (UE cm) picked from imported/triggers/<id>.json — our picks, not extracted star data; the originals' star points live in the unread mission table. Missions whose chain/auto start needs no star omit star_location. Interior stars (area != 0) are kept for later waves and skipped with a one-time log in v1. The arrival/day_one boot chain stays in DefaultGame.ini (BootMission) and is not in this table.
